title: Down at the Pool
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds air, ure, er
note_for_grown_ups: The last Phase 3 teams: ow (cow), oi (coin), ear (hear), air (chair), ure and er (winter). Your child now has all of Phase 3 — enjoy this one slowly.

pages.text: Ned ran down to the pool.
pages.illustration: Ned walking down a grassy slope towards the pond in the early morning, dew on everything, his tracks behind him in the wet grass.
The sun clearing the hedge, its light spreading across the pond surface in a bright path. Ned a small silhouette at the water's edge.
Ned with his head cocked, listening, and a cow visible over the hedge in the middle distance, its head raised. Quiet rural morning.

pages.text: A coin is in the soil.
pages.illustration: Close on dark soil with a small round coin half buried, one bright edge catching the sun. Ned's beak reaching towards it.

pages.text: Ned sees a pair of hens.
pages.illustration: Two hens picking about together on the bank, drawn as a pair, comic and busy. Ned watching them with interest.
Olive the owl perched with great dignity on the back of an old wooden chair left out by the pond. Absurd and stately.
Wide dusk view of the pond going pink and grey, reeds black against the water, everything settling for the night.
Ned turning away from the water to head home, one last look back over his shoulder. Small figure, big landscape.
Closing page: Olive on the chair and Ned walking off up the slope, both waving. Warm last light on the pond behind them.
